name: Weighted Bench Dip
steps: Sit on a stable bench with a plate flat across your upper thighs and your hands on the edge beside your hips.
Plant your feet and slide your hips just clear of the bench, checking that the plate stays still.
Bend your elbows behind you and lower only as far as your shoulders remain comfortable.
Push the bench away to straighten your arms, then sit back on the bench before removing the plate.
tips: Keep your back close to the bench and stop descending before your shoulders roll forward painfully.
Place the weight plate steadily over your hip crease rather than near your knees so it stays balanced.
